name: robots/zayfod__pycozmo
title: Digital Dream Labs Cozmo (pycozmo.Client)
intro: Digital Dream Labs Cozmo (pycozmo.Client), adapted from zayfod/pycozmo. It reads `head_angle`, `lift_height`, `lift_angle`, `battery_voltage` and 2 more; runs `move_joints`. `move_joints`: command one or more actuated joints to target positions in joint space, optionally over a declared duration, and report whether the target was reached within tolerance. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/zayfod__pycozmo --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/zayfod__pycozmo --backend fake --mcp
